name: Shinozaki Sachiko
source:
The girl in red. Sachiko was once the vengeful spirit who was the previous host of Heavenly Host, but then was appeased by Ayumi and co., turning into a kind spirit. She is still trapped inside Heavenly Host, but thanks to Ayumi saving her before, wants to help her get out.

[From [url=http://corpse-party-fanon.wikia.com/wiki/Sachiko_Shinozaki_(CPD2)]Corpse Party Fanon Wiki[/url]]
